title: On the Limits of Execution Traces for Repairing Assertion Failures in LLM-Generated Code
title_zh: 论执行轨迹在修复 LLM 生成代码断言失败中的局限

paragraphs.en: 研究表明断言失败提供的执行轨迹信息有限，仅当测试暴露失败输入且为实现失误时断点调试才优于重采样。 Iterative repair returns a failed program's error to a large language model (LLM) and asks it to fix it. After iterative repair, the remaining failures are mostly assertion failures: with four Qwen2.5 models, they make up 79% of residual failures on BigCodeBench, all on HumanEval and 93% on LiveCodeBench. We argue, through an information view of the feedback, that an assertion failure says little about where the fault lies. We propose Breakpoint Debugging (BPD), which returns the failed program annotated inline with its variables' runtime values. We take the tasks that iterative repair failed to fix with five repair attempts and compare two ways of spending five further generations on them: BPD, and resampling. On BigCodeBench, BPD repairs 26.7% of these tasks against 22.4%, and its advantage grows with model size. On HumanEval, BPD outperforms resampling but only slightly, and on LiveCodeBench, fresh sampling repairs more (6.5% against 4.9%). Furthermore, BPD reduces unchanged-code resubmissions from 28% to 8% on BigCodeBench. Using only the first failing test's trace, it outperforms tracing all failing tests while using fewer tokens than both all-trace BPD and plain iterative repair. On LiveCodeBench, BPD gives no gain even on the public tests, so a visible failing input is not enough for a trace to help. These results match the information view: a trace helps only when the test exposes a failing input, and the fault is an implementation slip; otherwise, a repair loop should resample rather than trace.
paragraphs.zh: 研究表明断言失败提供的执行轨迹信息有限，仅当测试暴露失败输入且为实现失误时断点调试才优于重采样。迭代式修复会将失败程序的错误返回给大语言模型（LLM），并要求其进行修复。 经过迭代式修复后，剩余的失败大多是断言失败：在四个 Qwen2.5 模型上，它们占 BigCodeBench 上残余失败的 79%，在 HumanEval 上占全部，在 LiveCodeBench 上占 93%。 我们通过信息视角分析反馈，论证断言失败几乎不能说明故障所在的位置。 我们提出断点调试（BPD），它返回失败程序，并在程序中内联标注其变量在运行时的取值。 我们选取迭代式修复在五次修复尝试中未能解决的任务，并比较在它们上再花费五次生成的两种方式：断点调试（BPD）和重采样。 在 BigCodeBench 上，断点调试（BPD）修复了这些任务中的 26.7%，而重采样为 22.4%，且其优势随模型规模增大而扩大。 在 HumanEval 上，断点调试（BPD）略优于重采样；而在 LiveCodeBench 上，全新采样修复了更多任务（6.5% 对 4.9%）。 此外，在 BigCodeBench 上，断点调试（BPD）将未修改代码的重复提交比例从 28% 降到 8%。 仅使用第一个失败测试的执行轨迹，它就优于追踪所有失败测试，并且使用的 token 数少于全轨迹断点调试（BPD）和普通迭代式修复。 在 LiveCodeBench 上，即使在公开测试上，断点调试（BPD）也没有带来提升，因此仅可见失败输入并不足以让执行轨迹发挥作用。 这些结果与信息视角相符：只有当测试暴露了失败输入且故障是实现失误时，执行轨迹才有帮助；否则，修复循环应当重采样而不是追踪轨迹。
